question: Who among the following is the youngest mayor in India as of January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arya Rajendran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Arya Rajendran**, a **member of the Communist Party of India( Marxist)** became the youngest mayor in India at the age of **21**.
 
• She became **mayor of Thiruvananthpuram,** **Kerala's capital city.**
 
• **Mayor**
 
 
• In India for all practical purposes, the municipal commissioner, a bureaucrat appointed by the state government, is the de facto head of the municipal body.
 
• Although the mayor is considered to be the political and executive head of the city, they hardly have any executive power.
